subject: Contrack kickoff - entity repository as the assistant memory layer
body:
All,

Starting Contrack today. The bet: our open-source context tracking work already treats entity recognition, attribute classification, coreference and plural-mention resolution as one end-to-end task over an entity repository, instead of four bolted-together models. That repository is exactly the thing our assistant team keeps hand-rolling badly, and because it updates incrementally turn-by-turn it stays cheap on long sessions - which is the whole product argument.

Milestones inside the window (Apr 13 - Jun 22):
- Apr 30: reproduce the published numbers on our internal dialogue set.
- May 22: turn-by-turn repository update running under 40ms p95 on a 60-turn session.
- Jun 12: integration spike with the assistant runtime, demo-ready for launch review.

Bruno owns staffing and will come back with the resourcing plan next week. Fumiko, you are tech lead.

Anders
